````typescript
// Zod Schema for validation

  title: z.string().min(1, { message: "Title is required." }),
  date: z.date({ required_error: "A valid date is required." }),
  time: z.string().regex(/^([0-1]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$/, { message: "Time is required in HH:MM format." }),
  meetingType: z.nativeEnum(MeetingPlatform, { required_error: "Meeting type is required." }),

  linkedContactSearch: z.string().optional(), // This is a temporary field for the input
  notes: z.string().optional(),
});

type ScheduleMeetingFormData = z.infer<typeof scheduleMeetingSchema>;

interface ScheduleMeetingDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  onMeetingScheduled?: (newMeeting: Meeting) => void; // Callback after successful scheduling

}

export function ScheduleMeetingDialog({
  isOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  onMeetingScheduled,
}: ScheduleMeetingDialogProps) {
  // const { toast } = useToast(); // Example toast usage
  const [selectedContacts, setSelectedContacts] = useState<string[]>([]); // Example state for linked contacts

  const form = useForm<ScheduleMeetingFormData>({

      setSelectedContacts([]);

  async function onSubmit(data: ScheduleMeetingFormData) {
    try {
      const [hours, minutes] = data.time.split(':').map(Number);

      const newMeetingData: Omit<Meeting, 'id'> = {
        title: data.title,
        dateTime: combinedDateTime,
        meetingType: data.meetingType,
        // This is where you'd integrate the actual selected contact IDs
        // For now, it's empty or derived from a more complex linkedContactSearch handling
        linkedContactIds: selectedContacts, 
        notes: data.notes,

      console.log('New Meeting Data:', newMeetingData);

      const savedMeeting: Meeting = { ...newMeetingData, id: crypto.randomUUID(), dateTime: newMeetingData.dateTime as Date };

      // toast({ title: "Success", description: "Meeting scheduled successfully." });
      if (onMeetingScheduled) {
        onMeetingScheduled(savedMeeting);
      }
      onOpenChange(false); // Close dialog on success
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to schedule meeting:", error);
      // toast({ variant: "destructive", title: "Error", description: "Failed to schedule meeting." });

  // TODO: Implement contact search and selection logic for 'linkedContactSearch'

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>

        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
            <FormField

              name="title"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Title *</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Input placeholder="e.g., Initial Consultation" {...field} />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="date"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className="flex flex-col">
                    <FormLabel>Date *</FormLabel>
                    <DatePicker 
                      selected={field.value} 
                      onSelect={field.onChange} 
                    />
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="time"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>

                )}
              />
            </div>
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="meetingType"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Meeting Type *</FormLabel>
                  <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} defaultValue={field.value}>

            />
            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="linkedContactSearch"
              render={({ field }) => (
````

**2. Create a Mock Contact Service:**

This service will simulate fetching contacts. Later, you can replace this with actual API calls.

````typescript
import { Contact } from '@/types/models';

// Mock data - replace with API calls
const mockContacts: Contact[] = [
  { id: 'contact-1', name: 'Alice Wonderland', email: 'alice@example.com' },
  { id: 'contact-2', name: 'Bob The Builder', email: 'bob@example.com' },
  { id: 'contact-3', name: 'Charlie Brown', email: 'charlie@example.com' },
  { id: 'contact-4', name: 'Diana Prince', email: 'diana@example.com' },
  { id: 'contact-5', name: 'Edward Scissorhands', email: 'edward@example.com' },
];

/**
 * Simulates searching for contacts.
 * @param query The search query string.
 * @returns A promise that resolves to an array of matching contacts.
 */
export const searchContacts = async (query: string): Promise<Contact[]> => {
  console.log(`Searching contacts with query: "${query}"`);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!query) {
        resolve(mockContacts.slice(0, 5)); // Return some initial contacts or recently used
        return;
      }
      const lowerCaseQuery = query.toLowerCase();
      const results = mockContacts.filter(
        (contact) =>
          contact.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseQuery) ||
          (contact.email && contact.email.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseQuery))
      );
      resolve(results);
    }, 300); // Simulate network delay
  });
};

/**
 * Simulates fetching a contact by ID.
 * @param id The ID of the contact.
 * @returns A promise that resolves to the contact or undefined if not found.
 */
export const getContactById = async (id: string): Promise<Contact | undefined> => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            resolve(mockContacts.find(contact => contact.id === id));
        }, 100);
    });
};
````

````typescript
                  </Command>
                </PopoverContent>
              </Popover>
              {selectedLinkedContacts.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {selectedLinkedContacts.map((contact) => (
                    <Badge key={contact.id} variant="secondary">
                      {contact.name}
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="ml-1 h-auto p-0.5"
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveContact(contact.id)}
                      >
                        <XIcon className="h-3 w-3" />
                      </Button>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </FormItem>

            <FormField
              control={form.control}
              name="notes"
              render={({ field }) => (
                <FormItem>
                  <FormLabel>Meeting Notes</FormLabel>
                  <FormControl>
                    <Textarea
                      placeholder="Enter any notes for the meeting..."
                      className="resize-none"
                      {...field}
                    />
                  </FormControl>
                  <FormMessage />
                </FormItem>
              )}
            />
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose asChild>
                <Button type="button" variant="outline">
                  Cancel
                </Button>
              </DialogClose>
              <Button type="submit">Save Meeting</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </Form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

**Explanation of Changes in `ScheduleMeetingDialog.tsx`:**

1.  **Imports**: Added `Popover`, `Command` components from Shadcn/ui, `Check`, `ChevronsUpDown`, `XIcon` from `lucide-react`, `Badge`, `Contact` type, `searchContacts` service, and `cn` utility.
2.  **State**:
    *   `selectedLinkedContacts`: Stores an array of `Contact` objects that are selected.
    *   `contactSearchQuery`: Stores the current text in the contact search input.
    *   `contactSearchResults`: Stores the contacts fetched based on the `contactSearchQuery`.
    *   `isContactSearchOpen`: Controls the visibility of the contact search `Popover`.
    *   `isLoadingContacts`: Boolean to show a loading state while fetching contacts.
3.  **Zod Schema**: `linkedContactSearch` was removed as we are managing selections via component state. The `Meeting` type now expects `linkedContactIds: string[]`.
4.  **`useEffect` for Debounced Search**:
    *   A `useEffect` hook listens for changes in `contactSearchQuery`.
    *   It uses a `setTimeout` to debounce the search, meaning the `searchContacts` service is called only after the user stops typing for 500ms.
    *   It sets `isLoadingContacts` to true during the fetch and updates `contactSearchResults` with the results.
5.  **Contact Selection Logic**:
    *   `handleSelectContact`: Adds a contact to `selectedLinkedContacts` if not already present, clears the search query and results, and closes the popover.
    *   `handleRemoveContact`: Removes a contact from `selectedLinkedContacts`.
6.  **UI for Linking Contacts**:
    *   A `Popover` is used to display the search interface.
    *   The `PopoverTrigger` is a `Button` that shows how many contacts are selected or a placeholder text.
    *   Inside `PopoverContent`, a `Command` component is used:
        *   `CommandInput`: For typing the search query. Its value is bound to `contactSearchQuery`.
        *   `CommandList`: Displays search results or empty/loading states.
        *   `CommandEmpty`: Shown when no results are found or no query is entered.
        *   `CommandGroup` and `CommandItem`: Used to list the `contactSearchResults`. Each item, when clicked, calls `handleSelectContact`. Selected items are visually indicated with a checkmark and disabled to prevent re-selection from the list.
    *   Below the `Popover`, selected contacts are displayed as `Badge` components with a small "x" button to remove them.
7.  **`onSubmit` Function**:
    *   It now maps `selectedLinkedContacts` to an array of IDs (`selectedLinkedContacts.map(c => c.id)`) and includes this in `newMeetingData.linkedContactIds`.
8.  **Reset**: The main `useEffect` that resets the form on `isOpen` change now also clears contact-related states.

This setup provides a functional, albeit mock, contact search and selection within your meeting scheduling dialog. Remember to replace `searchContacts` in `contactService.ts` with your actual backend API integration.

````typescript
/**
 * Simulates searching for contacts.
 * @param query The search query string.
 * @returns A promise that resolves to an array of matching contacts.
 */
export const searchContacts = async (query: string): Promise<Contact[]> => {
  console.log(`Searching contacts with query: "${query}"`);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (!query) {
        // Return a subset if no query, e.g., recently used or first few
        resolve(mockContacts.slice(0, 5)); 
        return;
      }
      const lowerCaseQuery = query.toLowerCase();
      const results = mockContacts.filter(
        (contact) =>
          contact.name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseQuery) ||
          (contact.email && contact.email.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseQuery))
          // You could extend search to other fields if they exist on Contact type
          // (contact.phone && contact.phone.includes(lowerCaseQuery)) ||
          // (contact.role && contact.role.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseQuery))
      );
      resolve(results);
    }, 300); // Simulate network delay
  });
};

/**
 * Simulates fetching a contact by ID.
 * @param id The ID of the contact.
 * @returns A promise that resolves to the contact or undefined if not found.
 */
export const getContactById = async (id: string): Promise<Contact | undefined> => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            resolve(mockContacts.find(contact => contact.id === id));
        }, 100);
    });
};
````
